cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The car won't start. Excellent chance for a walk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And a free shower!

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brilliant. The shower's finally reached your feet.

mechanism: A treats successive travel failures as ever-better practical training opportunities, correcting B walking technique with strained outdoor expertise.
confusable: Simple minimisation denies the problem; A acknowledges each setback and enthusiastically assigns it a larger benefit.
comparison: Theatre alternative converts lost resources into creative opportunities rather than a physical training exercise.
seedUse: Car failure, rain and leaking shoe derive from D20-a; S03 adds actual route and walking corrections instead of the detached free-shower image.
